Every page the Buildpad CLI scaffolds is under `app/[lang]/` since CLI 2.3: the provider layout is `app/[lang]/(authenticated)/layout.tsx` and the root layout `app/[lang]/layout.tsx`. The hand-rolled provider sample follows the CLI 3.11 structure: a client `DaaSProviderWrapper` and a route-group `app/[lang]/(authenticated)/layout.tsx` without `<html>` or `<body>`, in place of a `RootLayout`.
